issues.text: Scene s4 at 11.4 s: the card title "It's not your fault" and the chip "distributional convergence" say the same thing twice; shorten the chip to the paper's own term and keep the title.
Scene s2 at 6.0 s: the chunk "instantly." stands alone as a one-word caption; group it with the words before it.

summary: The visuals and the sounds hold up; the on-screen text in s4 doubles itself and one caption chunk is a lone word, which breaks the reading rhythm. Fix the text pass and the reel passes.
